_provenance: Reconstructed 2026-08-30 from evidence that exists in the repo: the leg-completion record in AGENTS.md §14, the open-question log in §16, file modification times, and gates.py output. Nothing here is estimated or back-filled. The unit of delivery is one demo leg (§14), not an abstract story point, because legs are what the charter commits to and what can be verified as done. Sprint 2 is a forward commitment and its completed_points is 0 until the sprint closes.

went_well: Measured before building. The fine-tuning hypothesis was tested and rejected before hours were spent on it.
Held-out discipline held. The router blend weight was tuned on the training split alone and held-out scored once, at the end.
A negative result was kept and published rather than buried.
gates.py turned eight hand-checked acceptance criteria into one runnable command, and refuses to let SKIP count as PASS.
to_improve: Zero commits across the whole sprint. Every deliverable exists in exactly one place.
The golden path has never been run end to end against its own 6-minute gate.
Documentation drifted from measurement: AGENTS.md §16 still records the pre-encoder router number, and the README carried a stale test count for days.
The gate runner itself went unverified, so a broken gate reported SKIP for an unknown period.
